# EdgeActivityIndicator

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:edge-activity-indicator` · Kerf UI · component · Feedback

A layout-free top-edge activity strip with a traveling wave and an optional hanging status pill.

## When to use

Signal ambient background activity (server work, sync) along the top edge of the viewport without allocating layout or taking the pointer, with Kerf-owned motion and reduced-motion handling.

- Ambient, app-wide background activity (server work, sync) should be visible without a modal, a banner, or any layout shift.

**Not when:**

- Do not use for progress the user waits on or must read; use CornerStatus or a StateBanner.
- Do not use for known progress; use a progress bar.
- Do not use it as the only record of important state; the bars are hidden from assistive technology.

**Alternatives:**

- [CornerStatus](./corner-status.md) (nearest) — Use CornerStatus for readable, non-dismissible app-level progress.
- [LoadingSpinner](./loading-spinner.md) (nearest) — Use LoadingSpinner for local activity beside the affected control.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/edge-activity-indicator` — exports `EdgeActivityIndicator`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/edge-activity-indicator` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/edge-activity-indicator.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/edge-activity-indicator`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuiedge-activity-indicator) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- busy or idle
- with or without a status pill
- semantic tone
- safe-area inset or flush

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** the busy state; the optional status message; the tone.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: none · padding: none (layout role: feedback). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

- Fixed to the top edge below the device safe area; it allocates no layout.

## Accessibility

- The strip is aria-hidden and pointer-inert; the optional pill is a polite live region that holds text only while it shows. Under reduced motion the wave and scale stop and the strip and pill only fade.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-edge-activity-indicator`, `kui-edge-activity-indicator__strip`, `kui-edge-activity-indicator__message`.

Never put `kui-edge-activity-indicator`, `kui-edge-activity-indicator__strip`, `kui-edge-activity-indicator__message` on an element you write; render `EdgeActivityIndicator` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-edge-activity-indicator-z-index`, `--kui-safe-area-block-start`, `--kui-color-brand-fill-loud`, `--kui-color-brand-on-loud`, `--kui-color-neutral-fill-loud`, `--kui-color-neutral-on-loud`, `--kui-color-pop-fill-loud`, `--kui-color-pop-on-loud`, `--kui-color-success-fill-loud`, `--kui-color-success-on-loud`, `--kui-color-warning-fill-loud`, `--kui-color-warning-on-loud`, `--kui-color-danger-fill-loud`, `--kui-color-danger-on-loud`, `--kui-font-2xs`, `--kui-space-m`, `--kui-space-s`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
